title: A sorted set of ints
hints: `i, found := slices.BinarySearch(set, v)`: `found` answers `Has`, and `i` is where `v` is, or where it **would** go. Use `_` for the result you don't need.
Insert at the returned position: `return slices.Insert(s, i, v)`. In `Add`, return `set, false` early when `found` is true.
In `Remove`, if `found`, delete the single element at `i` with `slices.Delete(set, i, i+1)`: the range is half-open, like `s[i:j]`.
